deep_dive.executive_summary: Nebius is a Yandex spinoff building AI GPU cloud infrastructure with $1.32 billion deferred revenue backlog and $2.43 billion cash, offset by $4.1 billion debt and continuing operating losses. We start Lawrence owner cash at $0.12 per share after capex trough normalization and model backlog conversion at 35% growth years 1–5. At ~$45 per share, we expect -10.62% per year over seven years on the base case. AI inflection overlay reaches 28.8% per year only with aggressive backlog conversion assumptions. Moat unproven. Dhando none. Stance watch.
